_doc: Download sources written into site/models/manifest.json by scripts/chunk_models.mjs. chunkMirrors serve the repo's own site/models/<id>/part-NN.bin files for the git tag `models-<manifestVersion>` ({tag} is substituted); every chunk is <= 19,000,000 B because jsDelivr refuses GitHub files above 20 MB. whole[<modelId>] lists byte-identical copies of the original files (sha256 verified, evidence/sources_probe.json). The browser probes every source at run time and ranks them by measured speed; the same-origin source is always kept as the final fallback. Public accelerators (ghfast, ghproxy, jsdmirror, b-cdn) are ephemeral: remove entries that stop answering, add new ones here, re-run `npm run chunk -- --version <ver> --tier2`, commit, tag `models-<ver>`, push. Dropped 2026-11-05 after the live check (evidence/sources_live*.json): cdn.jsdelivr.net and gcore.jsdelivr.net answer Range requests on a compressed representation (Content-Range total != file size, no Content-Length; cdn.jsdelivr.net switches between the two representations per edge, which broke a mid-file download in Chromium); hf-mirror.com redirects to cas-bridge.xethub.hf.co with a 302 that carries no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so browsers fail the CORS check (curl -L only shows the last hop).
